test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the smallest number which when divided by 19 and 23 gives remainders of 13 and 17, respectively.
solution:
**Given: **

Divisor = 19, and 23 

Reminder = 13, and 17 

**Calculation:**

Difference between divisor and reminder

19 - 13 = 6 

23 - 17 = 6 

The difference between divisors and reminders is the same in all

According to the question,

we have The LCM of (19 and 23) = 437 

Now,

The smallest number = LCM - 5

⇒ 437 - 6 

⇒ 431 

**∴ The required number is 431.**
